settings.heading: Can't find your bottle again?
settings.text: Not with REEVUS, it alerts you when left behind and you can track its live location on your iPhone.

settings.heading: Hydrate and capture with one bottle
settings.text: Reevus is a high performance bottle that doubles as a secure magnetic phone stand.

settings.heading: Want to know more?
settings.features:
Built-in Apple Find My tracker lets you locate the bottle using the Apple Find My app.

MagSafe-compatible magnetic mount works as a phone stand, holder, or carry loop.

Thermal insulation keeps drinks hot for up to 12 hours or cold for up to 24 hours.
settings.specifications:
Bottle Specifications
Dimensions: 80mm (Dia) x 205.3mm (Height)
Volume: 700ml (23.67 fl oz)
Weight: 395g (13.92oz)
Material: Stainless steel bottle, ABS lid, zinc alloy, magnets and silicon sealing ring.

Warranty: 1 Year
settings.faqs:
Does REEVUS work when the bottle is empty?
Yes. Track your bottle on your iPhone’s Find My app any time.

How long does REEVUS keep drinks hot or cold?
Cold for 24 hours and hot for 12.
